europe_now.title: France suspends stun grenade usage during protests
europe_now.summary: The French government has suspended the use of stun grenades following student protests where a demonstrator sustained severe injuries. Authorities are addressing mounting public unrest regarding school policies, fuel prices, and agricultural concerns.

europe_now.title: Deadly missile strikes impact Ukrainian residential areas
europe_now.summary: Large-scale Russian missile attacks have resulted in significant casualties, destroying apartment blocks and prompting condemnation from Ukrainian leadership. Officials report numerous fatalities and injuries as emergency services respond to the devastation.
